description: Clean-slate serialization of Ruida VCF (VCutWorks) binary format for RDD6584G oscillating knife
git_commits: 171e2e7 — Initial VcfWriter implementation with clean-slate serialization
6423903 — [DOCS] add README.md, narrative report, open source references, B2B-Knowledge-Base docs

package_structure.vcf_parser/_writer.py: VcfWriter — header/body/trailer serialization, VcfLayer, VcfWriterError hierarchy, top-level write() API
package_structure.vcf_parser/_config.py: Machine profile loader (JSON), kinematic parameter defaults, material damping config

features: Header with magic (1.0.012/1.0.013) + layer blocks (210 B / 610 B)
Layer block encoding: output_flag, speed, color_bgr, cutter_type, H1, feed_count, H2, V-slot direction/comp/extensions
Body with GEOMETRY_SIG elements (polyline/polygon path encoding)
Top-level write(spec, path) API with SerializationError handling
Error hierarchy: VcfWriterError → InvalidGeometryError, UnsupportedFeatureError, SerializationError
Layer extraction: speed validation, color matching, cutter type, H1/H2, feed_count, output_flag
Color name mapping (14 known colors + custom fallback)
limitations: No full geometry element re-parsing (only layer metadata extraction)

tests/test_roundtrip.py — 5 integration tests (known file roundtrip, synthetic line, two layers, V-slot params, determinism)
